subtitle: WORLD ART DIRECTION — Contextual Studio Environments
changes: Replaced remaining legacy assassin-theme artwork in Talent Forge banners and illustrated guide/journal panels with matching original Citadel assets.
Added a contextual studio-art theme that changes with the active main application section, using existing hosted widescreen and portrait WebP artwork.
Illustrated Character Intelligence, Progression Intelligence, Sovereign Ascension, Azeroth Assistant, Addon Nexus, and alternate Living Azeroth without altering their gameplay research or forms.
Maintained responsive asset sizing, source-safe informational messaging, and existing authentication, build storage, music and performance controls.
Corrected blurry cinematic entrance imagery with a dedicated 1600 × 900 WebP landscape hero and framed chamber preview artwork.
Changed the five chamber destinations into a responsive portrait gallery, capped at the original 380px illustration width rather than stretching the portraits into landscape cards.
Improved first-view artwork loading and retained all studio links, user preferences, saved data, performance modes and account flows.
Added a self-contained Citadel Awakening gateway at the canonical site URL for fresh visits, with the app's heavy resources loading only after selecting the full companion.
Added five previewable chambers, searchable navigation, three locally pinned shortcuts and a recent-chamber launcher; all links open existing working studios.
Added optional distinct illustrated artwork for each chamber, falling back safely to existing hosted v9 artwork until installed.
Retained Cinematic, Balanced and Performance modes with reduced-motion respect, preserved all existing local save formats and Blizzard account controls.
Provided staged browser acceptance for the new gateway and protected the published Discord release index until verification.

Made Living Azeroth the canonical first-visit cinematic homepage, with premium artwork, five studio paths, and an Enter Companion action that safely reveals the original application; session-scoped dismissal and direct bypass avoid navigation loops.
Introduced Living Azeroth, a fully illustrated original cinematic entrance and five interactive destinations with adaptive fantasy presentation.
Built a reusable v9 visual engine with original SVG citadel and oracle artwork, atmospheric particles, source-aware visuals, and Cinematic/Balanced/Performance modes.
Enhanced the original Talent Forge with visual node selection, glowing allocated paths and a read-only selected-node inspector fed from existing Blizzard-reported talent text and rank controls.
Introduced a Living Armory presentation with selectable equipment slots and detail cards sourced strictly from existing Blizzard public equipment responses.
Added an Adventure Journal navigation and chapter styling around the existing Mythic+, raid and reputations research without inventing achievement or inventory records.
Transformed ZevRo | Azeroth Assistant into an illustrated Oracle persona with guided-response states while retaining the existing curated knowledge and Mission Architect.
Added cinematic styling and a five-chamber navigator to Sovereign Ascension, improved desktop/mobile responsiveness, opt-in performance settings and reduced-motion respect.
Preserved the v8.0 rollback branch, legacy saved-data formats, Battle.net Cloudflare Worker, existing original studios, Founder bubble and HYPER MUSIC without changing their logic.
Synchronized Player Handbook, Getting Started, developer test requests, QA device acceptance, Gateway and release notes; guarded Discord release draft remains staging until acceptance.
